cause: The model command incorrectly nested scripts/worker_eval_env.sh, which unsets PYTHONPATH. The source-view bootstrap then preserved only its Transformers path, so HiFloat4 and LightX2V project packages were absent. This launcher mistake was introduced by the agent; the native scientific operator was never executed.
repair: A new model-specific wrapper restores config/worker.env project paths, preserves the assigned CUDA UUID (or explicitly empty CPU visibility), and removes the CPU-only platform-skip flag. A separately identified future attempt needs independent authority.
resource_finding: Seven user-authorized nodes were inventoried. An idle A10080GB PCIe was chosen rather than changing GPU architecture; existing fixed runtime assets were copied into the HF cache, and all12 original model payload SHA256s passed. Existing asset-copy bytes are not new model-generated outputs.
